title: Healthy Church: Healthy Members
series: Healthy Church: Paul's Letter to Titus
description: Do you have your life together?
Living the kind of life we aspire to—good work, good friends, good times—is often hard to do without a sense of overwhelm and exhaustion. How can we get it together?
Our world will say: "Be led by your desires." But the Apostle Paul echoes the ancient philosophers in stating that the secret is: self-control.
In Titus chapter 2 we learn what self-control looks like in the life of different categories of Christian: older men, older women, younger women, and younger men.
More than that, we find a vision for how the self-control needed for renewal in godliness can only be learned in community, as we model and encourage godliness to one another.
But most fundamentally, we learn that the self-control required for a life of virtue is only possible as the Holy Spirit renews the desires of our hearts.
